join.joinCondition: t1.person_id = person_name.person_id AND (person_name.voided IS NULL || person_name.voided = 0) AND person_name.preferred = 1
t1.person_id = contacts.person_id AND (contacts.voided IS NULL || contacts.voided = 0) AND contacts.person_attribute_type_id = 71

columns.column: CASE WHEN ((cv.visit_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.visit pv WHERE pv.patient_id = cv.patient_id AND pv.voided = 0 AND pv.visit_id <> cv.visit_id AND pv.date_created >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(cv.date_created), 1) AND (pv.date_created < cv.date_created OR (pv.date_created = cv.date_created AND pv.visit_id < cv.visit_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.encounter pe WHERE pe.visit_id = pv.visit_id AND pe.voided = 0 AND pe.encounter_type = 167))) OR (cv.visit_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.encounter pe2 WHERE pe2.patient_id = et.patient_id AND pe2.voided = 0 AND pe2.encounter_type = 167 AND pe2.encounter_id <> et.encounter_id AND pe2.encounter_datetime >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(et.encounter_datetime), 1) AND (pe2.encounter_datetime < et.encounter_datetime OR (pe2.encounter_datetime = et.encounter_datetime AND pe2.encounter_id < et.encounter_id))))) THEN (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t1.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 55 AND (pi.voided IS NULL OR pi.voided = 0) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END

CASE WHEN ((cv.visit_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.visit pv WHERE pv.patient_id = cv.patient_id AND pv.voided = 0 AND pv.visit_id <> cv.visit_id AND pv.date_created >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(cv.date_created), 1) AND (pv.date_created < cv.date_created OR (pv.date_created = cv.date_created AND pv.visit_id < cv.visit_id)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.encounter pe WHERE pe.visit_id = pv.visit_id AND pe.voided = 0 AND pe.encounter_type = 167))) OR (cv.visit_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM amrs.encounter pe2 WHERE pe2.patient_id = et.patient_id AND pe2.voided = 0 AND pe2.encounter_type = 167 AND pe2.encounter_id <> et.encounter_id AND pe2.encounter_datetime >= MAKEDATE(YEAR(et.encounter_datetime), 1) AND (pe2.encounter_datetime < et.encounter_datetime OR (pe2.encounter_datetime = et.encounter_datetime AND pe2.encounter_id < et.encounter_id))))) THEN (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = t1.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 55 AND (pi.voided IS NULL OR pi.voided = 0) ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE NULL END

expressionOptions.expression: CONCAT(FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, t1.birthdate, et.encounter_datetime) / 12), ' ', MOD(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, t1.birthdate, et.encounter_datetime), 12), '/12')

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(cvm_ed.name, CAST(ed.diagnosis_coded AS CHAR)) ORDER BY ed.dx_rank SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.encounter_diagnosis ed LEFT JOIN etl.concept_value_map cvm_ed ON cvm_ed.concept_id = ed.diagnosis_coded WHERE ed.patient_id = t1.person_id AND ed.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND ed.voided = 0)

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), cn.name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), cn.name) SEPARATOR '; ') FROM amrs.orders o INNER JOIN amrs.drug_order dro ON dro.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN amrs.drug d ON d.drug_id = dro.drug_inventory_id LEFT JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = COALESCE(d.concept_id, o.concept_id) AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE o.encounter_id IN (SELECT ev.encounter_id FROM amrs.encounter ev WHERE ev.visit_id = et.visit_id AND ev.voided = 0) AND o.voided = 0 AND COALESCE(o.order_action, 'NEW') <> 'DISCONTINUE')

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT COALESCE(cn.name, CAST(r.value_coded AS CHAR), r.value_text) FROM amrs.obs r LEFT JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = r.value_coded AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE r.encounter_id = et.encounter_id AND r.concept_id = 10926 AND r.voided = 0 ORDER BY r.obs_datetime DESC, r.obs_id DESC LIMIT 1)
